name: Aggregate Balance Information 45
definition: Overall position, in a single security, held in a securities account at a specified place of safekeeping.

FinancialInstrumentIdentification.name: Financial Instrument Identification
FinancialInstrumentIdentification.definition: Financial instrument representing a sum of rights of the investor vis-a-vis the issuer.

InvestmentFundsFinancialInstrumentAttrib.name: Investment Funds Financial Instrument Attributes
InvestmentFundsFinancialInstrumentAttrib.definition: Elements characterising an investment funds financial instrument.

AggregateBalance.name: Aggregate Balance
AggregateBalance.definition: Total quantity of financial instruments of the balance.

SafekeepingPlace.name: Safekeeping Place
SafekeepingPlace.definition: Place where the securities are safe-kept, physically or notionally. This place can be, for example, a local custodian, a Central Securities Depository (CSD) or an International Central Securities Depository (ICSD).

CorporateActionOptionType.name: Corporate Action Option Type
CorporateActionOptionType.definition: Specifies the corporate action options available to the account owner.

PriceDetails.name: Price Details
PriceDetails.definition: Price of the financial instrument in one or more currencies.

ForeignExchangeDetails.name: Foreign Exchange Details
ForeignExchangeDetails.definition: Information needed to process a currency exchange or conversion.

DaysAccrued.name: Days Accrued
DaysAccrued.definition: Specifies the number of days used for calculating the accrued interest amount.

AccountBaseCurrencyAmounts.name: Account Base Currency Amounts
AccountBaseCurrencyAmounts.definition: Valuation amounts provided in the base currency of the account.

InstrumentCurrencyAmounts.name: Instrument Currency Amounts
InstrumentCurrencyAmounts.definition: Valuation amounts provided in the currency of the financial instrument.

AlternateReportingCurrencyAmounts.name: Alternate Reporting Currency Amounts
AlternateReportingCurrencyAmounts.definition: Valuation amounts provided in a currency other than the base currency of the account.

QuantityBreakdown.name: Quantity Breakdown
QuantityBreakdown.definition: Breakdown of the aggregate quantity reported into significant lots, for example, tax lots.

BalanceBreakdown.name: Balance Breakdown
BalanceBreakdown.definition: Breakdown of the aggregate balance per meaningful sub-balances and availability.

AdditionalBalanceBreakdown.name: Additional Balance Breakdown
AdditionalBalanceBreakdown.definition: Provides additional instrument sub-balance information on all or parts of the reported financial instrument (unregistered, tax exempt, etc.).

BalanceAtSafekeepingPlace.name: Balance At Safekeeping Place
BalanceAtSafekeepingPlace.definition: Breakdown of positions per place of safekeeping (and optionally per place of listing).

HoldingAdditionalDetails.name: Holding Additional Details
HoldingAdditionalDetails.definition: Provides additional information on the holding.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.

BalanceAtSafekeepingPlaceRule.definition: If SafekeepingPlace is present, then BalanceAtSafekeepingPlace is not allowed.

HoldingAdditionalDetailsRule.definition: Unless bilaterally agreed between the Sender and Receiver, if SubBalanceAdditionnalDetails is present, then it must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field.

FinancialInstrumentAttributesRule.definition: If InvestmentFundsFinancialInstrumentAttributes is present, then FinancialInstrumentAttributes is not allowed.
